documents.label: Topic maps
documents.hint: Graph layout organizes documents by latent topic mixtures. Bayesian text inference supplies word distributions; geometric spring forces and repulsion arrange the resulting graph.

documents.label: Semantic neighborhoods
documents.hint: Visual graph browsing explores semantic documents. Topic probability distributions connect word vocabulary, while spring layout preserves geometric neighborhood structure.

documents.label: Woodland surveys
documents.hint: Forest field surveys count plant species. Trees and soil describe woodland habitat and ecological diversity.

documents.label: Habitat restoration
documents.hint: Forest restoration supports habitat and species diversity. Woodland plants recover as soil and tree conditions improve.

documents.label: Seasonal plants
documents.hint: Seasonal field surveys describe forest plants. Ecological habitat and soil conditions shape woodland species diversity.

documents.label: Trees and soil
documents.hint: Trees connect forest soil and plant habitat. Field ecology measures woodland species and restoration diversity.

documents.label: Species diversity
documents.hint: Woodland habitat supports diverse plant species. Forest surveys connect ecology, soil and restoration.

documents.label: Ecological recovery
documents.hint: Forest restoration changes tree and plant communities. Habitat surveys measure ecological recovery and woodland species diversity.

documents.label: Elin Rowan
documents.hint: Forest ecology studies habitat, plants and species diversity. Woodland field surveys measure trees, soil and ecological restoration across seasons.

documents.label: Spring neighborhoods
documents.hint: Spring forces arrange graph vertices. Repulsion separates neighbors while graph layout geometry retains readable network structure.

documents.label: Local geometry
documents.hint: Graph drawing balances spring attraction and repulsion. Geometry and spatial neighborhoods guide network browsing.

documents.label: Readable maps
documents.hint: Readable graph layout aligns vertices and labels. Spring forces and geometric distances preserve neighborhood context.

documents.label: Motion and forces
documents.hint: Graph springs create motion. Repulsion and damping stabilize spatial graph layout while local neighborhoods remain recognizable.

documents.label: Browsing structure
documents.hint: Visual network browsing explores local graph structure. Geometric spring layout preserves context around neighboring vertices.

documents.label: Graph lenses
documents.hint: A spatial lens expands a graph neighborhood. Spring layout and repulsion supply graph geometry before viewing transforms.

documents.label: Topic library
documents.hint: Collection root. Browse authors and their papers.

documents.label: Mira Vega
documents.hint: Graph layout geometry uses spring forces, repulsion and readable network neighborhoods. Visual graph browsing preserves local structure and spatial context.

documents.label: Niko Chen
documents.hint: Probabilistic topic models describe documents with word distributions. Bayesian inference samples latent topics and retrieves text with semantic vocabulary.

documents.label: Latent documents
documents.hint: Topic models represent documents as mixtures. Bayesian inference samples latent topics from word counts and document vocabulary.

documents.label: Words and probability
documents.hint: Probability distributions connect words and latent topics. Topic inference retrieves documents with shared semantic vocabulary.

documents.label: Sampling text
documents.hint: Gibbs sampling estimates Bayesian topic distributions. Documents share word vocabulary through latent text mixtures.

documents.label: Semantic retrieval
documents.hint: Document retrieval compares probabilistic topics. Text mixtures combine word evidence and Bayesian latent inference.

documents.label: Topic explanations
documents.hint: Word distributions explain latent document topics. Bayesian probability and vocabulary support interpretable text retrieval.

documents.label: Corpus mixtures
documents.hint: A text corpus contains document mixtures of latent topics. Word counts drive Bayesian inference and probability estimates.
